coverage_truncation_caveat: the default pull reads only `filings.recent` (~1,000 most recent filings per CIK, all forms); a heavy filer's 8-K history is TRUNCATED at its coverage_start. Absence of a row before coverage_start is truncation, not evidence of no filing. --full-history fetches the older pages.
pit_rule: availability = acceptance_datetime (EDGAR acceptance, UTC). event_date is when the thing happened; it is NEVER the knowability gate.
survivor_caveat: universe resolved via company_tickers.json = CURRENT registrants; names delisted before the map's fetch date are absent
